free_tier.stated: Monthly-prepaid GPU host with four listed models and nothing in stock as of 2026-10-22. Cheapest listed configuration is an RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell at USD 185 per month, which the tracker divides to USD 0.25 per GPU-hour over 730 hours. Terms quoted from the vendor's own documentation: block storage USD 4 per TB per month, bandwidth included on every plan, billing monthly and prepaid, minimum rental one month, and cancelling gives no partial refund.

chaining: A USD 185 month with bandwidth included is a fixed-cost way to hold one card continuously, but LeaderGPU's USD 140 month for a 3090 is cheaper and this is a commitment, so it only composes with a workload that runs for most of 730 hours.

limits.value: A one-month prepaid commitment with no partial refund is the binding term: a cancelled month is a lost month, and none of the four configurations was in stock on the day checked.
